OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
## 🚀 KuCoin PROOF: Tis the Season (550,000 USDT Prize Pool)
Celebrate Black Friday and the festive season with the KuCoin PROOF: Tis the Season Futures Contest! Compete across three action-packed challenges plus bonus perks to claim your share of 550,000 USDT.
## 🏆 Track 1: Solo Volume Leaderboard (150,000 USDT Pool)
Top Rank Pool (120,000 USDT): The Top 200 traders by Futures volume share 120,000 USDT in cash and Futures Points—plus extra Grand Lucky Draw entries to win a Tomorrowland Winter package, event tickets, and End-of-Year KuCoin gift bags.
Sunshine Pool (30,000 USDT): Qualified non-ranking participants split a 30,000 USDT reward pool!
## 📈 Track 2: PnL TraderPro Challenge (100,000 USDT Pool)
1,000 USDT Trial Funds: Open to everyone! Register to receive 1,000 USDT in Lead Trading Trial Funds and earn from both your own trading profits and follower profit-sharing.
Dynamic Prize Pool: Reach ≥ 20,000 USDT in eligible trading volume and finish with a positive PnL to qualify. The Top 100 Lead Traders by PnL share the unlocked 100,000 USDT pool.
## 🎡 Track 3: Daily Spin Wheel — 100% Guaranteed Wins (200,000 USDT Pool)
100% Win Rate: Spin daily for 0.1 BTC, 1 ETH, 1,000 XRP, cash vouchers, Tomorrowland Winter packages,tickets, and End-of-Year KuCoin gift bags.
1-in-3 Instant Cash: Enjoy a 30% chance to land instant cash starting from 1 USDT.
Easy Unlocks: Complete daily missions starting at 800 USDT in volume to earn spins.
## 🎁 Extra Festive Perks: New User & Referral Bonuses (100,000+ USDT Pool)
New User Bonus (100,000 USDT Pool): Sign up and trade to get a 100 USDT Futures Airdrop Position Voucher (first 1,000 new users, first-come, first-served).
Referral Airdrop (10,000 USDT Pool): Invite a new user to register, enroll in the challenge, and achieve ≥ 100 USDT in eligible Futures trading volume each to receive a 50 USDT Futures Airdrop Position. Referrers may claim up to 3 times and invitees once.
35% Super Commission: Eligible participants can unlock an upgraded 35% referral commission rate.
## 💡 Track Your Progress
Earn Futures Points on the Solo Leaderboard to redeem for Position Airdrops, Fee Vouchers,or Quarterly Cash—all on the Futures Arena Dashboard!
## 📅 Event Timeline (UTC+8)
From 12:00 on November 16, 2026 to 00:00 on December 1, 2026 (UTC+8)
## Ready to celebrate and trade your way to the top?
Notes
Rewards are subject to eligibility and distribution rules.
Futures trading involves risk and may result in losses. Please trade responsibly.
Apple is not a sponsor and is not involved in this activity in any manner.
KuCoin reserves the right of final interpretation of this campaign.
Sign Up on KuCoin Now
Dive Into KuCoin's Global Communities

Headline: Copy Trading Advancement Program Phase 6: 200,000 USDT to Support Steady Trading

OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
To help more users achieve steady growth through Copy Trading, the “Copy Trading Advancement Program” is back. With tiered task designs and three progressively unlocked challenges, complete the tasks to receive exclusive rewards. Share a limited-time prize pool of 200,000 USDT—this event will support your advancement every step of the way.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 24, 2026, 08:00–December 19, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Event 1: Copy Trading Challenge
Meet the required amount for a single copy trade and generate a copy trade to claim tiered rewards.
Single Copy Trade Amount (USDT) | Reward Amount (USDT) | Number of Rewards (Units)
≥ 200 | 100 | 500
≥ 500 | 200 | 200
≥ 1,000 | 500 | 100
## Event 2: Daily Copy Trading Check-In
Accumulate copy trading days and complete one Futures copy trade each day to successfully check in.
Total Copy Trading Days | Reward Amount (USDT) | Number of Rewards (Units)
7 Days | 50 | 300
10 Days | 100 | 200
15 Days | 200 | 100
## Event 3: Copy Trading Experience Reward
Follow 3 different lead traders and complete valid copy trades to receive a reward of 100 USDT. The event prize pool is 5,000 USDT, available on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Event Rules
Participants must click the 【Join Now】 button on this event page to register. Failure to register indicates that the participant is not eligible to participate.
Participants must generate eligible copy trades during the event period and complete Identity Verification to receive rewards.
Rewards will be distributed as position trial vouchers on a first-come, first-served basis and will be credited to users’ accounts within 14 business days after the event ends.
Gate will verify accounts, trades, and fund transfers during the event. Violations include using multiple accounts to participate repeatedly, impersonating others or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, repeatedly circulating on-chain funds, organizing efforts to obtain rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that affects the fairness of the event. Upon verification, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the relevant users from receiving rewards.
In the event of any discrepancy between translated versions and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
Due to changes in market conditions, fraud risks, and other factors, Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this event. If you have any questions, please contact Gate Official Customer Support.

OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
The Bitget CFD Championship (phase 23) is here! Share 75,000 USDT across four reward pools. Join now to unlock your exclusive rewards!
Promotion period: November 23, 2026, 9:00 PM – November 30, 2026, 9:00 PM (UTC+8)
CFDs: XAUJPY, XAUJPY.s, XAUJPY.pro, XAUAUD, XAUAUD.s, XAUAUD.pro, XAUEUR, XAUEUR.s, XAUEUR.pro, XAUUSD, XAUUSD.s, XAUUSD.pro, XAGAUD, XAGAUD.s, XAGAUD.pro, XAGUSD, XAGUSD.s, XAGUSD.pro, EURUSD, EURUSD.s, EURUSD.pro, GBPUSD, GBPUSD.s, USDJPY, USDJPY.s, USDJPY.pro, AUDUSD, AUDUSD.s, AUDUSD.pro, USDCAD, USDCAD.s, USDCAD.pro, UKOUSD, UKOUSD.s, UKOUSD.pro, USOUSD, USOUSD.s, USOUSD.pro, UKOUSD.pro, XAUJPY.p, XAUAUD.p, XAUEUR.p, XAUUSD.p, XAGAUD.p, XAGUSD.p, EURUSD.p, GBPUSD.pro, GBPUSD.p, USDJPY.p, AUDUSD.p, USDCAD.p, UKOUSD.p, USOUSD.p
Join now
## Reward pool 1: Surprise Mystery Boxes
1. There are several daily tasks during this promotion. Each completed task grants you one Mystery Box with guaranteed rewards.
2. Daily tasks refresh at 12:00 AM (UTC+8). Make sure to complete them within the day.
3. Mystery Box supply is limited and available while supplies last. Plan ahead and participate early to avoid missing out.
## 4. Daily tasks—trading volume tasks:
New CFD user task: Place your first CFD trade with a volume of over 4000 USDT to get three Mystery Boxes.
Daily task 1: Total CFD trading volume exceeding 50,000 USDT grants one Mystery Box.
Daily task 2: Total CFD trading volume exceeding 200,000 USDT grants one Mystery Box.
## Reward pool 2: Referral rewards
1. Existing Bitget CFD users can invite new users to sign up. Once a new user completes the designated CFD trading tasks, both the inviter and the invitee will receive rewards.
Task | Referral tasks | Inviter reward | Referral reward
Task 1 | Sign up on Bitget and reach a CFD trading volume of 10,000 USDT | 3 USDT | 3 USDT
Task 2 | Reach a total CFD trading volume of 200,000 USDT | 3 USDT | 3 USDT
2. Referrals who reach a total CFD trading volume of more than 300,000 USDT during the promotion period are eligible to share a 4000 USDT reward pool, with individual rewards capped at 50 USDT.
3. Inviters will be ranked based on the number of valid new users they successfully refer during the promotion period and can earn up to an additional 100 USDT in rewards.
Ranking | Rewards (USDT) | Minimum referrals required
1st–5th | 100 | 40
6th–20th | 60 | 25
21st–53rd | 20 | 10
## Reward pool 3: Trade daily to earn credits
1. Daily credits accumulation: Earn one credit whenever your daily CFD trading volume reaches a designated tier. You may earn multiple credits by reaching multiple tiers. For example, you can earn one credit by reaching a trading volume of 50,000 USDT in a single day, two credits for 100,000 USDT, three credits for 200,000 USDT, and so on. There's no cap on the number of credits you can earn daily.
2. The corresponding reward pool is 7600 USDT. Reward calculation for users who meet the credit requirement: My reward = my credits ÷ total eligible credits × reward pool.
3. Credit threshold: The credit threshold for this promotion will be announced within one day after the promotion ends.
## Reward pool 4: Championship leaderboard
1. During the promotion, the user ranked 1st by CFD trading volume will exclusively receive 4000 USDT, and the user ranked 2nd will exclusively receive 3000 USDT. The total pool is 47,400 USDT. The rankings and rewards are as follows.
2. Users must meet both the ranking and minimum trading volume requirements to qualify for the corresponding reward tier. If only one requirement is met, rewards will be distributed based on the lower qualifying tier.
Ranking | Individual reward (USDT) | Minimum trading volume (USDT)
1st | 4000 | 1,000,000,000
2nd | 3000 | 500,000,000
3rd | 2000 | 400,000,000
4th–6th | 1000 | 300,000,000
7th–10th | 600 | 200,000,000
11th–50th | 300 | 80,000,000
51st–100th | 200 | 50,000,000
101st–220th | 50 | 20,000,000
221st-470th | 20 | 8,000,000
## Notes
1. Users must use the
Join Now button to register for the promotion. The promotion includes four reward pools, and users are eligible to win from different pools.
2. During the promotion, orders are tracked daily from 12:00 AM to 11:59 PM (UTC+8) for credit calculation. Credits are awarded based on the actual order execution date.
3. Rewards will be distributed to eligible accounts within five working days after the promotion ends. Users can check their rewards in their spot accounts.
4. This promotion is exclusive to regular users. Sub-accounts, institutional users, PRO accounts, and market makers are not eligible to participate.
5. All participants must strictly comply with Bitget's terms and conditions. Bitget reserves the right to disqualify any user from participating in the promotion and confiscate their rewards if any fraudulent conduct, illegal activities (such as using multiple accounts to claim rewards), or other violations are found.
6. Bitget will conduct a review of all users and promptly disqualify those who employ any technical means, including but not limited to electronic, robotic, repetitive, or automated methods, for the purpose of automated or repeated registration and participation, and invalidate their rewards across all their accounts.
7. Due to legal and regulatory requirements, some users may be unable to sign up for a Bitget account, or access may be temporarily restricted in certain countries or regions. Refer to Bitget's terms and conditions for the latest information.
8. Bitget reserves the right to amend, revise, or cancel this promotion at any time without prior notice, at its sole discretion. Bitget reserves the right to the final interpretation of the promotion. Contact customer service if you have any questions.

Exchange/platform: Paradex
Headline: Paradex XP Season 3: 4,000,000 XP shared every week
Start: 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z · End: not stated
Note: the rules text below may be incomplete (only the announcement preview was available).
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Season 3 started on February 1, 2026; end date TBD. A pool of 4,000,000 XP is distributed every Wednesday.
XP is earned for contributing to the platform: trading, providing liquidity and community activity. Linking X and Discord helps the team tell real users from Sybils.
Season 3 introduces a new XP earning mechanic (details in the official docs as they are published).
Payout: XP (points, not money) is credited every Wednesday for the previous week. XP itself cannot be withdrawn or sold; its future value is not promised.
XP is Paradex's reward system; earlier seasons' XP was converted into a share of the DIME token supply. No value of future XP is promised.
